mapper.sql: l.id, l.energy_data_id, l.order_id, l.model_name, l.prompt_snapshot, l.diagnosis, l.suggestion, l.status, l.error_msg, l.duration_ms, l.create_time, l.update_time, d.enterprise_id, d.energy_type, e.enterprise_name, e.workshop_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_diag_log (energy_data_id, model_name, prompt_snapshot, status) VALUES (#{energyDataId}, #{modelName}, #{promptSnapshot}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_ai_diag_log l JOIN t_energy_data d ON d.id = l.energy_data_id JOIN t_enterprise e ON e.id = d.enterprise_id WHERE l.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM t_ai_diag_log l JOIN t_energy_data d ON d.id = l.energy_data_id JOIN t_enterprise e ON e.id = d.enterprise_id
ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_diag_log SET status = 'SUCCESS', diagnosis = #{diagnosis}, suggestion = #{suggestion}, order_id = #{orderId}, error_msg = NULL, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE t_ai_diag_log SET status = 'FALLBACK', diagnosis = #{diagnosis}, suggestion = #{suggestion}, order_id = #{orderId}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_ai_diag_log SET status = 'FAILED', error_msg = #{errorMsg}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_ai_diag_log SET status = 'RUNNING', error_msg = NULL, duration_ms = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED'
